prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a quiet original transparent vignette for Previously.'s real iOS welcome / login screen. Produce ONLY the isolated decorative art, never a UI mockup.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual current welcome screen, a palette and hierarchy reference. Preserve its understated nearly-black character. Image 2 is a material reference: graphite hinged panels, soft ivory and tiny coral accent.
Primary request: an original miniature personal screening nook, inviting and restrained. One low charcoal lounge chair facing a single thin graphite widescreen hinged episode panel, in a compact low oval graphite stage. The screen is angled gently toward the chair and is mostly charcoal, with a subtle off-white reflected light along its inner edge, no bright white rectangle. Two barely visible offset panel edges behind it suggest episodes kept over time. One tiny coral period-like round detail on the screen's lower corner. No person, no TV/show imagery, no play symbol, no lettering or logos. No remote-control clutter.
Style: beautiful premium tactile 3D editorial sculpture, precise thin matte materials and restrained soft light. Softly rounded architectural forms, quiet charcoal-on-charcoal depth. The composition is low and wide, 3:2 overall shape, near-frontal 3/4 view; all elements readable when scaled to 220 by 140 points.
Palette: graphite #242428 and #303034 on transparent alpha; ivory #F4F1EC only in tiny highlights; coral #F0563F only one small dot. Designed to rest on #09090B. Avoid a warm beige/paper/fabric palette.
Constraints: true transparent background, no scene wall or backdrop, no external floor or glow halo. Keep scene tightly grouped with transparent margin. No neon, particles, spotlight beams, saturated colors, glossy chrome, confetti, text, characters, brands, copyrighted fictional locations. Keep the art quieter than the wordmark and sign-in action in Image 1.
